author: implementation-agent

findings.summary: Author lifespan formatting is duplicated instead of shared.
findings.consequence: A future change to how author lifespans are rendered can update `app/lib/author-profile.ts` without updating this server variant, causing author document and SLA article pages to diverge from profile pages while existing profile tests still pass.
findings.evidence: `formatYears` implements the same null/`0000` filtering and `birth-death`/`f.`/`d.` formatting as `formatAuthorYears` in `app/lib/author-profile.ts:144`; similar copies also exist in library tooltip and Dramawebben author year formatting.
findings.recommendation: Move the shared lifespan formatter to a shared module, for example `shared/utils/author-years.ts`, and have both server author-document code and app profile code call that single implementation with focused shared tests.
